_comment: Buildertrend Schedule items marked complete from the Daily Logs (Victor, 11/19/26: 'stucco pronto, stucco ready, stucco feito… no Daily Log → marcar o Stucco concluído'). Each log is split into its bullet points; a point marks an item when it names the item ('item' regex on the item title, 'words' regex on the text) AND says it is done ('done') AND does not say it is partial, in progress, scheduled, waiting, failed or a repair ('not'). The more specific entries come first and the text they match is removed, so 'stucco grading concluído' never marks Stucco. Evidence date = the earliest Daily Log that says it.

_comment_2026_11_20: Victor 11/20/26: 'isso só leve quando disser que foi de fato efetuada' — a Daily Log counts only when it says the work was actually done: future / scheduling / inspection sentences and the bot's own logs (Bot PKB) never count. Date: the date the text gives for the work ('10/02', 'Saturday 10/03', 'last Friday', 'ontem'), else the log date; a date mentioned but not understood → no exact date (the planned date stays).
